item.title: Montana Supreme Court justice McKinnon faces traffic charge
item.description: Montana Supreme Court Justice Laurie McKinnon has been charged with a misdemeanor, after sheriff’s deputies said she failed to slow down while passing a stopped emergency vehicle.

item.title: Who let the dogs out: TRACS adopts out over 1000 dogs in 2025
item.description: The Thompson River Animal Care Shelter just turned 20. In that time, the shelter has taken in more than 15,000 animals.

item.title: DPHHS gives lawmakers updates on Montana State Hospital, rural health funding
item.description: Almost four years after the state hospital lost a key federal certification – and access to funding that went with it – leaders say they’ve officially submitted a request to get that status back.
